headline.purpose: Section titles and the contact email.

label.purpose: Data labels in mono, controls in sans.

motion.name: ease-settle
motion.purpose: The hero statement on load, and the After bar when first seen.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action. Solid ink, never the accent.
components.html: Email me about a project
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding-inline: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--ink); color: var(--on-ink); font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color .15s, border-color .15s; } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--ink-2); border-color: var(--ink-2); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The secondary action beside the primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding-inline: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 4px; color: var(--ink); font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color .15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--surface); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Tag
components.description: A small mono status beside a case title.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 0; color: var(--ink-2); font: 400 .8rem/1.4 var(--mono); } .ds-tag::before { content: ""; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent); }

narrative.overview: The page behaves like a well-kept engineering record: a ruled sheet where every line sits on the grid and every claim has a number beside it.
keyCharacteristics: Vertical rails and full-width hairlines make the grid itself the visible structure.
Geist at tight tracking for statements, Geist Mono for data and quiet labels.
One green accent, reserved for one meaning: delivered and measured.
Light and dark are two tuned palettes, and the closing section behaves differently in each.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Green means delivered and measured. It never colours a button, a link at rest, a heading or a background field.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: If something needs to look lifted, it gets a lighter or whiter surface and a hairline, never a box-shadow.
